documents.title: Inbound SOP
documents.content: The warehouse in Bhiwandi receives inbound trucks between 7 AM and 3 PM. Drivers must carry the e-way bill and a printed gate pass. Unloading bays 1 to 4 are reserved for temperature-controlled goods. Pallets must be shrink-wrapped and labelled with the purchase order number. Damaged goods are photographed at the bay and logged in the receiving system before the driver leaves.

documents.title: Shipping FAQ
documents.content: Q: How long does shipping take? A: Domestic orders arrive in 3 to 5 business days. Q: Can I change my delivery address? A: Yes, until the order is packed. Q: Do you ship internationally? A: We ship to 18 countries; duties are paid by the buyer. Q: How do I return an item? A: Start a return from My Orders within 30 days of delivery. Q: When is my refund processed? A: Within 5 business days after the warehouse receives the item. Q: Can I pay cash on delivery? A: Cash on delivery is available for orders under 5000 rupees. Q: Is gift wrapping available? A: Yes, for a small fee selected at checkout. Q: How do I contact support? A: Write to support@example.com or use the in-app chat. Q: Do you offer bulk discounts? A: Orders of 50 units or more qualify for tiered pricing. Q: Are prices inclusive of tax? A: Yes, all listed prices include GST.

documents.title: Orders API v2
documents.content: GET /v2/orders returns a paginated list of orders. Use the cursor parameter for the next page. POST /v2/orders creates an order; the body must include customer_id and at least one line item. PATCH /v2/orders/{id} updates mutable fields such as shipping address and notes. DELETE /v2/orders/{id} cancels an order that has not shipped. Shipped orders return 409 Conflict. All endpoints require a bearer token in the Authorization header. Tokens expire after 60 minutes. Rate limits are 100 requests per minute per token; exceeding them returns 429 Too Many Requests. Timestamps use ISO 8601 in UTC. Monetary amounts are integers in the smallest currency unit. Webhooks are signed with HMAC-SHA256; verify the X-Signature header before trusting the payload. Idempotency-Key headers are honoured for 24 hours on POST requests. Errors follow RFC 7807 problem details with type, title, status and detail fields.
